name: MCL Profit-Memory Pullback Resumption Census
hypothesis: After V18 banks a failed-auction profit-memory exit, one completed parity-aligned CL and MCL pullback followed by a completed parity-aligned break of both pullback extremes may distinguish genuine continuation financing from blind same-direction re-entry.
source_exit: V18 basis_breadth failed-auction position closed causally by profit_memory; the census may use exit time and direction but no PnL value or later path

candidate_law.window: strictly after the source exit, within the same Globex session and suffix, and strictly before the next raw V18 CL turn
candidate_law.bars: only complete five-minute CL and MCL bars whose full interval begins after the exit
candidate_law.pullback: first completed bar whose own open-to-close moves oppose the exited direction in both CL and MCL
candidate_law.resumption: first later completed bar whose own open-to-close moves align with the exited direction in both CL and MCL and whose closes cross the directional CL and MCL extremes of that first pullback bar
candidate_law.entry_readiness: next one-minute same-suffix MCL open exists outside the 16:25–18:00 ET admission blackout
candidate_law.multiplicity: at most one candidate per source exit/raw-turn epoch
candidate_law.direction_authority: unchanged V18 direction; the pattern may only re-arm it

if_eligible: Freeze one exact V18-compatible re-entry lifecycle, primary/stress costs, and selection gates before reading candidate PnL. Do not sweep breakout distance, pullback count, hold, stop, or timeout.
if_ineligible: Reject pullback-resumption re-entry before outcomes; do not widen sessions, reuse partial bars, cross a raw turn, or lower cohort floors.
